s1.desc: a restaurant drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a table under a long white tablecloth and a plate of sandwiches in front of him

beats.text: Pax sits on a mint chair at the table with his flippers flung out wide, eyeing the sandwiches
Pax reaches over to the plate and picks up half a sandwich
Pax lifts the sandwich to his beak and takes a bite
Pax munches the sandwich with his eyes closed and a happy smile
Pax opens his eyes and keeps nibbling the sandwich held in both flippers

spans.notes: locked: tablecloth band (y 0.55-0.75, x 0-0.4) scale 1.0000, <=0.3 px at cc >= 0.999 f16-f62 and f1-f14 (f15, f18-19 rows dip while Pax's flipper reaches the plate); compare 0/62 table and chair edges black. A pan starts at f63. No overlay in the top third or bottom fifth

spans.view: with a long table under a white tablecloth set with sandwiches and a platter of sushi rolls

beats.text: Pax keeps nibbling his sandwich at his end of the table
Polly sits at the other end of the table and reaches toward a platter of sushi rolls
Polly pops a piece of food into her beak, eyes open
Polly chews the bite with her eyes closed and a smile

spans.notes: pan left along the table from Pax to Polly f63-f71 (tablecloth band: scale 1.006 and 1 px at f63, 38 px at f65; Pax leaves at the right edge f70, Polly comes in on the left f69), then a slow push and drift until it settles at f88 (band vs f76: scale 1.011 at f79 to 1.019 at f91 relative; vs f85: still moving to f88, constant from f88). Otherwise keepable (U3)

a Polly-like waiter: a pink-bodied penguin (pink flipper tips, white face) with a brown bowl-cut hairdo and an orange shirt with a white triangle print pushes a dessert cart in from the left and leaves again, visible f105-131 (shirt-colour count at the left edge drops to the constant cart value at f132). Polly sits at the table at the same time, so it is clearly someone else: an unfilled lookalike drop under the 2026-11-04 ruling (like Polly's mum). Rest of the shot: Polly eats sushi with her eyes closed, glances at the cart, takes a bite. Camera locked f88-148 (table-edge band y 0.55-0.8, x 0.8-1.0: scale 1.0000 +-0.0003, <=1 px at cc 1.000). Without the waiter only f88-104 and f132-148 remain (17 frames each), so the whole shot is one span

spans.view: with a round table of sushi and sandwiches between two dessert carts piled with cakes, pancakes and sundaes

beats.text: Polly glances across and then turns toward the food while Pax leans in and reaches toward the plates in front of him
Polly takes a bite from her fork with her eyes closed while Pax sits back holding a bite of food at his chest
Polly stretches her fork across the table toward the platter while Pax keeps holding his food
Polly brings the forkful back to her beak while Pax lifts his food toward his face
Polly nibbles from her fork with rosy blushing cheeks while Pax munches the food held in both flippers

spans.notes: locked: compare 149/210 keeps both carts, the table and the chairs black. No waiter or lookalike in this shot; no overlay in the top third or bottom fifth. Skit ends on this shot
